snippet.title: Turbo Loop NextFest Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game built around simple gameplay that is easy to pick up, yet challenging to master. Whether you're chasing perfect lap times or battling head-to-head, every race is about precision, timing, and control.

Take on AI opponents, challenge a friend in local multiplayer, and push your skills across a wide variety of tracks. Unlock new cars, fine-tune their look, and create your own racing circuits with a simple and easy-to-use track editor.

Demo will soon be available on Steam, please wishlist and follow to get notified when the Demo and full game are released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4710220/Turbo_Loop_Demo/
